title: Buffer
intro: The Buffer lets you build a personal buff scheme — a saved list of buffs that can be applied to your character with a single click. No NPC hunting required once your scheme is set up.

figure.alt: Buffer panel showing buff groups and scheme controls
figure.caption: The Buffer panel — buff groups in columns, Apply Scheme and Clean Scheme at the bottom.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
steps: Open the Community Board (`Alt+B`) and select **Buffer** from the left menu.
Browse the buff groups — each column represents a category (combat, support, etc.).
Click the **+** button next to any buff to add it to your saved scheme.
Click **Apply Scheme** to instantly cast all saved buffs on your character.
Your scheme is saved per character and persists between sessions — set it up once and reuse it anytime.

cells: Applies all buffs in your scheme to your character.
Removes all buffs from your saved scheme (does not remove active buffs).

tables.title: Level Up Buffer — Additional Custom Buffs

figure.alt: Level Up Buffer panel showing additional custom buff slots
figure.caption: Level Up Buffer panel — unlocked after 150 Rebirths.

tables.preText: After reaching **150 Rebirths** you unlock access to the **Level Up Buffer**, which grants 10 additional custom buffs on top of your normal scheme. Each buff slot is purchased separately with L-Coins.

cells: P.Def +400%, M.Def +400%, Max HP +100%, Max CP +400%
DEX +25, WIT +25, PvE Physical Skills Damage +400%, PvE Magical Damage +400%
P.Atk +600%, Critical Damage +200%, Physical Skill Power +200%
Spoil Rate +25%, Drop Rate +25%, Adena Drop Rate +25%
Global Drop Limit Multiplier +300%, Global Drop Limit Bonus +2,000

tables.title: Unlock Cost per Buff Slot
tables.preText: Buff slots are unlocked one at a time in order. Each slot costs more than the previous.

infoBoxes.label: Requirement
infoBoxes.body: The Level Up Buffer is locked until **150 Rebirths** are completed.

infoBoxes.label: L-Coin
infoBoxes.body: L-Coin drops from regular mobs, raid and world bosses, and seasonal events.

infoBoxes.label: Total Investment
infoBoxes.body: Unlocking all 10 buff slots costs **950,000 L-Coins** in total.
